method: Independent manual inspection of decoded repaired source bytes and the frozen support-term, elaboration, attack and occurrence contracts; fresh review of all five repairs and their finite graphs/counters. For 91 unchanged cases, reuse only the hash-identical prior independent judgments, with exact input/meaning/counter equality and unchanged vocabulary/construction ancestry, with explicit corrected code-commit and recipe-version provenance. Read and executed author-prepared finite audit as a checked enumerator, not as the source of independent judgment. No production driver or analysis implementation was imported or executed. Legacy controls retain their disclosed golden origin.

fresh_repair_review.only_input_edits: Append after-policy clone r-s-new of r-s, and change only new-attacker rule reference to r-s-new. All other decoded input fields equal the original.
fresh_repair_review.support_identity: SRule identity includes rule ID, substitution, recursively nested premises, discharge map, holes and assurance. Argument and derived claim IDs are absent. Empty substitution/discharges/holes and AssuranceNone apply here.
fresh_repair_review.typing: Seed is a declared observed nullary atom. Parameter-free defeasible rules seed->t, seed->s, t->v and fresh seed->s have matching premise/conclusion signatures. Existing witness/consumer/attacker terms are unchanged; the fresh rule supplies the new attacker. No questions, certifiers or holes. Contrary s->t validates both declared rebuts against defeasible witness.
fresh_repair_review.graph: Before roots witness, consumer, attacker. After adds new-attacker with a distinct rule ID. Both attackers are unattacked; each attacks witness and its consumer via structural occurrence containment. Witness and consumer are defeated. The fresh attacker enters the witness incoming ancestry, so locality is false while status stays defeated.
fresh_repair_review.source_axis: Levels 0,1,4,16 add that many fresh observed leaf/root groups and nullary signature entries to each endpoint; the inert terms cannot contain witness and receive no edge. This adds 0,2,8,32 declarations per endpoint.
fresh_repair_review.finite_counters: For g groups: histories=1, sources=3, declarations=20+4g, search-steps=1, pairs=38+5g, subsets=0; source-bytes is the actual file byte count.
fresh_repair_review.expected_results: All 96 expected ASTs exactly match original; T07 remains accepted-to-accepted, defeated-to-defeated, changed=false, locality=false.
fresh_repair_review.certificates: Five repairs have no certificate requests; all other certificate bytes and semantic judgments are unchanged and bound to prior input/meaning hashes.

guard_review.scope: Bounded annotation shape prerequisite only; does not infer source typing or prove arbitrary core equality. Reviewed actual old T07 clone negative, distinct-rule positive, field completeness, duplicate/ambiguous IDs, question rejection and malformed/unsupported rule fields, including unused rules.

validation.author_prepared_finite_audit: 80 exact authored AST checks; no findings
validation.consumer_receipt: 96 input/expected AST decodes; manifest/input/oracle and actual consumer binary hashes independently checked
